title: LEARN
paper_title: LEARN: Learned Experts' Assessment-Based Reconstruction Network for Sparse-Data CT
core_mech: LEARN 每个展开阶段并行计算 CT 数据梯度和 learned experts CNN 正则梯度，再做残差更新。
core_mech_en: Unrolls K iterative sparse-view CT reconstruction stages where each stage combines an explicit projection residual gradient A^T(Ax^t − y) with a stage-specific 3-layer CNN regularizer.
input_desc: 稀疏视角 CT 投影 y、系统矩阵 A/Aᵀ 和初始图像 x0
input_en: Sparse-view CT sinogram y, system projection matrix A / backprojection A^T, and initial image x^0
output_desc: 固定阶段后的 CT 重建 xN
output_en: Reconstructed CT image x^K after K≈50 unrolled expert stages

source.title: LEARN
notes: Author-associated MATLAB/MatConvNet code for Learned Experts' Assessment-based Reconstruction. Repository describes CUDA requirement.

adapter.name: LEARN
adapter.mechanism: Each stage combines its own three-layer CNN regularizer with an explicit A-transpose projection residual.
limitations: Three unrolls and a pixel-driven parallel-beam operator; positive step parameters are bounded through softplus scaling.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
